Lina (People Ops): Hannah flagged a discrepancy: her April paystub shows both CA and WA state withholding. she lives in WA and only did one CA meeting day.
Hannah Lee (Employee): i was in SF for a client meeting on 2026-03-28. i updated my address in Workday last year to WA and submitted WA withholding form.
Omar (Payroll): pulling payrun 2026-04-15 for Hannah (EMP-3142). export shows site code CA for that day and our rule applied site-state withholding when any CA site days present. that overwithheld CA tax.
TJ (Manager): oops, we logged the client day but didn't mark it as "travel". apologies.
taxbot: policy note: short business travel < 14 days should not change resident withholding unless employee elects otherwise.
Omar (Payroll): plan: 1) request Hannah confirm WA withholding form on file; 2) run off-cycle to reclassify CA->WA for payrun 2026-04-15; 3) patch rule to require >5 site days before changing resident withholding.
Hannah Lee (Employee): confirmed WA form on file. happy to have payroll reclassify.
Lina (People Ops): please log the change for audit and notify Hannah when refund posts.
Omar (Payroll): off-cycle queued 2026-04-18 10:00 UTC. projected refund $22.45 credit to net pay. recorded note: "Reclass CA->WA for EMP-3142 payrun 2026-04-15."
Hannah Lee (Employee): saw credit today. thanks all! :)
Lina (People Ops): closing thread.
